title: STEALTH: Steganographic Text Encoding Agnostic to Low-Level Tensor Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.16928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Provably secure linguistic steganography hides a message inside text sampled from a language model, so that without the key, a stegotext is computationally indistinguishable from an honest model sample. Nearly every such scheme assumes the receiver can recompute the sender's token probabilities exactly bit for bit. We show this assumption is fragile: across three model families, bit-exact schemes decode almost none of our messages once the receiver's floating-point precision, quantization, or GPU architecture differs from the sender's, or even when the receiver merely scores a text in parallel versus one token at a time, with the same model, precision, and hardware held fixed. We present STEALTH, a scheme built for exactly this setting. translated_title: STEALTH：对底层张量硬件不可感知的隐写文本编码
translated_abstract: 可证明安全的语言学隐写术将消息隐藏在从语言模型采样的文本中，使得在没有密钥的情况下，隐写文本在计算上与诚实的模型采样输出无法区分。几乎所有此类方案都假设接收方能够逐位精确地重新计算发送方的 token 概率。我们证明这一假设是脆弱的：在三个模型家族上，一旦接收方的浮点精度、量化方式或 GPU 架构与发送方不同，甚至当接收方仅仅以并行方式（而非逐个 token 的方式）对文本进行评分时——即使模型、精度和硬件完全相同——位精确方案也几乎无法解码我们的任何消息。我们提出了 STEALTH，一个专为这种场景构建的方案。发送方利用由带密钥的伪随机噪声驱动的指数竞争来抽取每个 token，因此只有当竞争结果非常接近时，接收方的概率失配才会翻转某个 token；一种无速率的脊形码（spinal code），解码...
tldr: STEALTH 提出了一种新颖的语言学隐写方案，通过带密钥伪随机噪声驱动的指数竞争机制与无速率脊形码相结合，使得即使发送方与接收方的硬件、精度或评分方式存在差异，隐写文本依然能够可靠解码，从而摆脱了传统方案对逐位精确概率复现的脆弱依赖。
en_tdlr: STEALTH is a linguistic steganography scheme that uses keyed pseudorandom exponential races combined with rateless spinal codes, enabling reliable decoding even when the receiver's hardware, precision, or scoring method differs from the sender's, thus removing the fragile dependence on bit-exact probability recomputation.
